historical_result.preceding_snapshot: Step 3 listed the Set status button after opening the account menu; step 4 timed out waiting for the :visible selector.

diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen actions 1-3, then read-only button geometry at 0, 2 and 5 seconds; no Set status click or status mutation

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 原轨迹打开 GitLab 账号菜单后，快照已列出 Set status 按钮，但紧接着的 :visible 点击超时。相同的冻结前缀下，官方 Moli 1.1.6 的按钮存在、未禁用、样式可见、页面加载完成，而按钮及父容器的布局矩形持续五秒为零；固定候选中两者均为 238×32。失败不是按钮缺失或等待页面加载不足，而是菜单更新后布局几何未刷新，使依赖几何的可见性筛选排除了目标；这与已复现的脏布局快照故障家族一致。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: After the original GitLab account menu opened, the snapshot listed Set status, but the following :visible click timed out. With the same frozen prefix, official Moli 1.1.6 had an enabled button, visible computed style and a complete page, while both button and parent rectangles stayed zero for five seconds; the fixed candidate gave both a 238×32 rectangle. The failure was neither a missing button nor insufficient page-load waiting. Stale geometry after the menu update excluded the target from geometry-dependent visibility matching, consistent with the reproduced dirty-layout-snapshot defect family.

scope_limit: Read-only same-page 1.1.6-versus-fixed geometry evidence; no status change, formal 1.1.3 post-fix rerun, repeated-flake estimate, or commit-level bisect. The historical official score remains unchanged.
